name: Havells India Ltd.
business_summary: Electrical products leader: cables & wires (47% of Q2 FY27 sales), switchgear, lighting & fixtures, electrical consumer durables (fans, water heaters, appliances) and the Lloyd brand (ACs, refrigerators, washers). Debt-free, ROCE ~25%, EBITDA margin ~9%. Profit is exposed to copper/aluminium (inventory swings and cable contribution margin), construction and industrial capex cycles, and competition in cables and Lloyd. Stock is -28% in 12 months after margin pressure; UBS downgraded in Oct 2026.

revenue_mix.segment: Switchgear, lighting, ECD and Lloyd (split approximate)

exposures.mechanism: Cables ~47% of sales; copper+aluminium ~70% of cable COGS (~33% of group revenue). Pricing is metal-linked with ~30 days of stock: +10% copper => ~Rs70cr inventory gain (~3% of TTM EBITDA Rs2,302cr) on cables, minus higher costs in Lloyd/fans/switchgear and some demand elasticity; persistence 0.25 => ~+0.8. Pack empirical +0.96 (t=1.8) agrees. Pack gold +1.51 (t=2.5) and silver +0.91 (t=2.0) show metal-complex co-movement without a business link and are ignored.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: revenue Rs6,417cr (+34.6%), EBITDA Rs576cr (+30.5%), margin 8.98% vs 9.27%; cables Rs2,999cr (+47.9%) with contribution margin 13.9% vs 17.7% on aluminium price fall

exposures.mechanism: Aluminium cables/conductors: falling aluminium cut cables contribution margin to 13.9% from 17.7% in Q2 FY27 (inventory loss/repricing). Aluminium is -19.6% since June, so +10% would restore ~+0.5 via inventory gain and mix; partially offset by costs in fans/ACs.
